caption: The drawing depicts a single, old-fashioned lantern centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The lantern features a wide, round base in a grayish metallic color, supporting a clear glass globe. The globe is encased by thin, curved metal wires that form a protective cage around it, also rendered in a gray metallic tone. The upper part of the lantern consists of a domed metal cap with a perforated vent and a cylindrical section just above the glass globe. At the top, there is a curved metal handle attached on either side of the cap, arching upwards and outwards. The lantern has a small flame visible inside, with a short wick and a brass burner. The surface details, such as metallic reflections and shadows, are illustrated with shades of gray and light blue, while the transparent glass allows partial view of the flame and writing on its surface. The background is plain and unadorned, with some faint lines and marks suggesting the edges of the page.
title: Kerosene Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
